interpretation: Offline weather is a constructed reference scenario: selected-month temperature normal plus 2024 observed annual mean wind/RH. Direction is a scenario setting, not a prevailing-direction distribution. Rain totals are context only, never converted into continuous rainfall or probability. Turbulence, pressure, cloud distance, daylight and visibility are explicit assumptions. Mean wind is NOT a safe maximum and this is NOT today's weather. The annual-report URL is rolling; retain the stated report year.
